snapshots.profile_text: Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response 64.2K posts Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC We're America’s largest LGBTQ+ civil rights organization. Follow us here and on Bluesky for updates: bsky.app/profile/hrc.org. Media requests: press@hrc.org Washington, DC hrc.org Joined January 2009 120.5K Following 722.3K Followers Posts Replies Media Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC Dec 19, 2019 Trans women are women. Trans men are men. Non-binary people are non-binary. CC: JK Rowling. Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC Oct 2, 2017 Sandy Hook. Virginia Tech. Aurora. San Bernardino Pulse. Las Vegas. Countless others. Congress must act to finally end gun violence. Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC Jan 6, 2020 Kate McKinnon gets emotional at #GoldenGlobes honoring Ellen DeGeneres....and we did too. 00:00 Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC Jan 25, 2021 BREAKING: President Biden has ended the ban on transgender military service set in place under the Trump administration. A grateful nation salutes all who have served and hoped for this moment. Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC Feb 2, 2021 BREAKING: The Senate has confirmed @PeteButtigieg as Transportation Secretary, making him the first-ever openly LGBTQ person to be confirmed by the Senate to a Cabinet-level position. Another barrier broken for our community. Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC Jul 1, 2024 Preach @tarajiphenson! Project 2025 is a REAL threat to all of us. Every part of it is a wrecking ball for our lives, our families, and our rights. #BETAwards 00:00 Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC May 17, 2019 BREAKING: The House of Representatives has passed the historic #EqualityAct. It’s the first time a chamber of Congress has approved a comprehensive LGBTQ civil rights bill that would finally provide clear, nationwide protections for LGBTQ people throughout daily life. 00:00 Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC Sep 28, 2018 ‘You have passed a polygraph...Judge Kavanaugh has not. You have called for outside witnesses to testify...Judge Kavnauagh has not. You have called for an FBI investigation into the facts. Judge Kavnauagh has not.’ Senator @KamalaHarris to Dr. Blasey Ford. #BelieveSurvivors 00:00 Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC Dec 1, 2020 "I love that I am trans. And I love that I am queer." Sending you all the love in the world, Elliot. 💙💖⚪ Elliot Page @TheElliotPage Dec 1, 2020 Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC Jun 1, 2023 💖 🤍 💙 🖤 🤎 ❤️ 🧡 💛 💚 💙 💜 💖 🤍 💙 🖤 🤎 ❤️ 🧡 💛 💚 💙 💜 💖 🤍 💙 🖤 🤎 ❤️ 🧡 💛 💚 💙 💜 ✨✨✨ It's Pride Month ✨✨✨ 💖 🤍 💙 🖤 🤎 ❤️ 🧡 💛 💚 💙 💜 💖 🤍 💙 🖤 🤎 ❤️ 🧡 💛 💚 💙 💜 💖 🤍 💙 🖤 🤎 ❤️ 🧡 💛 💚 💙 💜 Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC Jan 23, 2019 💙 We 💗 really ⚪ really 💗 really 💙 really 💗 really ⚪ really 💗 really 💙 really 💗 really ⚪ really 💗 really 💙 really need all trans people to know that they are loved. Human Rights Campaign Rapid Response @HRC Jan 21, 2
